title: SB1472 (2023-2024): Firearms: California Do Not Sell List.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check, California); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official leginfo.legislature.ca.gov text (Amended 2024-03-19, via LegiScan getBillText)
provenance.note: Version read: Amended 2024-03-19; no floor vote on file. Same amendment strikes the earlier text of the bill (Penal Code 30105 firearms eligibility check), so only the new Chapter 6 remains.

operative_text: Section 30180 (Penal Code): 30180. (a) The Department of Justice shall develop and launch a system to allow a person who resides in California to voluntarily add their own name to, and subsequently remove their own name from, the California Do Not Sell List, hereafter the registry. The purpose of the registry is to prevent the sale or transfer of a firearm to a person through a lawful method. The department shall ensure that the system does all of the following credibly: (1) Verifies the identity of a person who opts to register or requests removal. (2) Prevents unauthorized disclosure of a person registering or requesting removal. (3) Informs the potential registrant of the legal effects of registration or removal. (b) In implementing subdivision (a), the department shall utilize, to the extent feasible, existing state and local resources, systems, databases, and staff.
